description: Release refspec zsh braces. Brace the /release push refspec so it works in zsh, and guard skill and doc shell blocks against unbraced $NAME:<letter> (#1331).

userStories.title: Brace the release push refspec and guard skill code blocks
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want the `/release` push command to work in zsh. Then a release push from the sandbox does not fail on a mangled refspec.
acceptanceCriteria: A new test file `.agro/scripts/__tests__/skill-shell-portability.test.ts` scans each fenced `bash` or `sh` block in `.agro/skills/**/*.md` and `docs/**/*.md`. The test fails on an unbraced variable that a colon and a letter follow, for example `$SHA:r`.
The test reports the file, the line, and the variable for each finding.
The test fails on the current `development` branch with the finding `.agro/skills/release/SKILL.md` line 162 `$SHA`, and the test passes after the change.
`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` holds one `### Fixed` entry that links issue #1331.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: diff shows git push "${REMOTE}" "${SHA}:refs/heads/${TARGET}"; no other match in the file. 2-3 executed: skill-shell-portability.test.ts scans fenced bash/sh blocks in .agro/skills and docs, reports file/line/variable via toEqual([]). 4 executed by worker: red with finding {file: .agro/skills/release/SKILL.md, line: 162, variable: $SHA}, exit 1; green after. Detector cases: "$SHA:refs" one finding; "${SHA}:refs", "$PATH:/usr/local/bin", text block none. 5 executed on task branch: pnpm test exit 0 (89 files, 1857 passed). 6 executed: [Unreleased] ### Fixed entry links #1331. 7 executed: pnpm typecheck exit 0. Also pnpm build and pnpm lint exit 0; git grep for quoted $NAME:<letter> in .agro/skills and docs prints no line.
